_comment: Reading what a board is running, Klipper first. Every guard here is a wrong-answer shape rather than a crash: a digest read as 1 instead of absent, a join key that never matches, a name left unconverted. Each one produces a board that is running exactly what we flashed and is reported as needing a flash forever, because no reflash can clear a formatting difference. So each has to be shown load-bearing.

mutations.name: the hex string Klipper sends is parsed as hex
an unparseable digest is absence, not an exception out of a status read
a boolean digest is absence, not the number 1
a boolean image bound is absence, not the number 1
mutations.find: if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):

mutations.name: the two sources' spellings of one serial are normalised before joining
the algorithm name becomes an id at the reader's boundary
a sensor object with no serial yields no entry
mutations.find: if not isinstance(serial, str) or not serial.strip():

mutations.name: the wire source converts INFO into the same report Klipper's answer is
only the fields the reporter names are asked for, inside a sub-second budget
mutations.find: query: dict[str, Any] = {name: list(reporter.klipper_fields) for name in names}
mutations.replace: query: dict[str, Any] = {name: None for name in names}

mutations.name: Klipper's answer is preferred over the wire
the wire is consulted when Klipper had no object
